statements.text: The group is exposed with role group and named by its label attribute; without a label it is an unnamed group.

events.description: Emitted when the group's disabled state changes, for its options.
events.name: group-state-change

examples.html: <violet-listbox label="Seed source" value="regional"><violet-option-group disabled label="Archived suppliers"><violet-option aria-disabled="true" aria-selected="true" id="violet-option-1" label role="option" selected value="regional">Regional catalog</violet-option><violet-option aria-disabled="true" aria-selected="false" id="violet-option-2" label role="option" value="coop">Local co-op</violet-option></violet-option-group></violet-listbox>

<violet-listbox label="Seed source" value="regional"><violet-option-group label="Current suppliers"><violet-option aria-selected="true" id="violet-option-1" label role="option" selected value="regional">Regional catalog</violet-option><violet-option aria-selected="false" id="violet-option-2" label role="option" value="coop">Local co-op</violet-option></violet-option-group></violet-listbox>

summary: Labelled group of violet-option elements inside a violet-select, violet-combobox or violet-listbox.

usage.text: The label attribute renders a visible heading above the group's options.
The disabled attribute on the group makes every option inside it unselectable, whatever the options' own disabled state.
The select and combobox modules do not import this element; when importing per element, import the option-group module too or the group stays undefined.
